name: Unintended Consequences
tagline: Good intentions. Surprising results. Real lessons.
description: A daily narrative podcast profiling inventions, policies, and systems that were meant to help — but triggered surprising, unintended consequences. From the Cobra Effect to social media algorithms, every episode follows a single case study through good intentions, implementation, unexpected fallout, and the lessons we can learn.
